join a local data frame to a remote NCBI Gene parquet resource

Source: R/join_ncbi.R
join_ncbi_gene.Rd

join a local data frame to a remote NCBI Gene parquet resource

Usage

join_ncbi_gene(
  local_df,
  by,
  resource = "gene_info",
  taxid = NULL,
  type = "left"
)

Arguments

local_df

data.frame to join against the remote resource

by

character vector of column name(s) to join on; must exist in both local_df and the remote resource

resource

character(1) parquet resource name, with or without .parquet suffix; must be one of available_ncbi_parquet()

taxid

integer(1) or NULL; when non-NULL, pre-filters the remote resource to this taxonomy ID

type

character(1) "left" (default) or "inner"

Value

lazy dplyr::tbl – pipe select/filter/collect as needed

Note

local_df is written to the persistent duckdb session. The returned tbl is lazy; call collect() to retrieve results. Both sides of the join run entirely in duckdb.

Examples

if (is_online()) {
  local_df <- data.frame(Symbol = c("ORMDL3","TP53","BRCA1"))
  join_ncbi_gene(local_df, by = "Symbol", taxid = 9606L) |>
    dplyr::select(Symbol, GeneID, map_location) |>
    dplyr::collect()
}
#> # A tibble: 3 × 3
#>   Symbol GeneID map_location
#>   <chr>   <dbl> <chr>       
#> 1 TP53     7157 17p13.1     
#> 2 ORMDL3  94103 17q21.1     
#> 3 BRCA1     672 17q21.31
